documented_probe: C-409f50fe (gpg-encrypt an archive and remove plaintext intermediates): covered at medium difficulty; the verifier independently decrypts, checks OpenPGP cipher 9 / S2K hash 10, requires wrong-passphrase rejection on a hidden case, and sweeps /app and /tmp for surviving plaintext archives.
notes: Single multi-tool stage: build a transient tar snapshot strictly under /tmp, symmetric-seal it with gpg (--cipher-algo AES256, --s2k-digest-algo SHA512, batch/loopback passphrase-file), remove every plaintext intermediate, and record the cipher name. The verifier re-runs the deliverable with hidden source dirs/passphrases in both invocation styles, diffs decrypted trees byte-for-byte, inspects packets, and enforces wrong-passphrase rejection and the no-intermediates sweep. Rubric weights tool_breadth (tar/gzip/gpg/mktemp), unsafe_action_penalty (leaving cleartext snapshots), and adversarial/generalization checks; totals bucket to medium.
